meta.note: the English release text with the tone, jokes and personalities of the JAPANESE original (docs/TRANSLATION.md); strings not listed here stay the original English

001A.t: It smelled faintly of a young{SoftNewLine}girl...{ContinuePrompt}

001B.t: The contents were so wild, it{SoftNewLine}only made you dizzy.....{ContinuePrompt}

0050.t: {Speaker}Yep, that there's{SoftNewLine}{Item}. {Number} golds. Fine{SoftNewLine}stuff, ain't it?{WaitInput}

0052.t: {Speaker}Thank ya kindly!{SoftNewLine}Take good care of it, now.{WaitInput}

0053.t: {Speaker}Ya ain't got enough{SoftNewLine}golds, mister! Go earn some{SoftNewLine}an' come back!{WaitInput}

0055.t: {Speaker}Hold it right there!{SoftNewLine}Don't go walkin' off with my{SoftNewLine}goods!{WaitInput}

005B.t: {Speaker}Now, now, that{SoftNewLine}won't do! That belongs to the{SoftNewLine}goddess. Put it back, please!{WaitInput}

0080.t: {Speaker}W-wait! D-don't{SoftNewLine}touch that book! It's full of{SoftNewLine}dangerous spells! Yes, spells!{WaitInput}

0083.t: {Speaker}Oh dear... Very{SoftNewLine}well. O goddess, forgive me!{WaitInput}

0084.t: {Speaker}W-wonderful book,{SoftNewLine}eh? Please keep it a secret{SoftNewLine}from the villagers, will you?{WaitInput}

0085.t: {Speaker}Wise choice, my{SoftNewLine}child! You'll go far in this{SoftNewLine}world. Ahem.{WaitInput}

0086.t: {Speaker}No, no! Don't take{SoftNewLine}it outside! If anyone sees it,{SoftNewLine}my reputation is ruined!{WaitInput}

0097.t: {Speaker}Thirty years in the{SoftNewLine}item business! If it's fresh{SoftNewLine}gear ya want, leave it to me!{WaitInput}

00AF.t: {Speaker}Mercator, town of{SoftNewLine}bargains! 30% off! 40% off!{SoftNewLine}C'mon, buy, buy, buy!{WaitInput}

00B7.t: {Speaker}Nigel! Looking for{SoftNewLine}something? I'll give you a good{SoftNewLine}price!{ContinuePrompt}

00C1.t: {Speaker}Welcome, welcome,{SoftNewLine}ya see! This hotel is the{SoftNewLine}place to stay, ya see!{WaitInput}

00C3.t: {Speaker}Ah! You can't take{SoftNewLine}that for free, ya see!{WaitInput}

00C4.t: {Speaker}If you're staying,{SoftNewLine}come to the counter, ya see.{SoftNewLine}{Number} golds a night.{WaitInput}

00C6.t: {Speaker}Thank you kindly,{SoftNewLine}ya see. Rest well, now.{WaitInput}

00C7.t: {Speaker}Oh, you're all{SoftNewLine}better, ya see! Take care out{SoftNewLine}there.{WaitInput}

00C8.t: {Speaker}Not enough golds,{SoftNewLine}ya see... Maybe next time.{WaitInput}

00DC.t: {Speaker}You're the hero{SoftNewLine}who saved our town! Special{SoftNewLine}price: just {Number} golds!{NewLine}

00E5.t: {Speaker}Hey! What're you{SoftNewLine}doing?! Bring your parents{SoftNewLine}here, I wanna have a word!{WaitInput}

00E6.t: {Speaker}You won't go on a{SoftNewLine}rampage, right? Good. Then{SoftNewLine}you're welcome here.{WaitInput}

00E7.t: {Speaker}...Who's this comin'{SoftNewLine}to my Underground Shop, where{SoftNewLine}nobody ever comes?{ContinuePrompt}

00E9.t: {Speaker}Come again. You're{SoftNewLine}the only customer I've had in{SoftNewLine}200 years!{WaitInput}

00EA.t: {Speaker}Well, that won't{SoftNewLine}do! In 200 years, nobody ever{SoftNewLine}did such a thing!{WaitInput}

0148.t: {Speaker}The treasures of{SoftNewLine}King Nole, ya say...? Hmmm...{SoftNewLine}hmm! ...Never heard of 'em!{WaitInput}

0149.t: {Speaker}They smashed the{SoftNewLine}bridge... I hope our young{SoftNewLine}hotheads don't do somethin'{SoftNewLine}crazy...{WaitInput}

014A.t: {Speaker}Nabu abidabu, nabu{SoftNewLine}abidabu... O gods, please{SoftNewLine}protect my Fara!.....{WaitInput}

014C.t: {Speaker}Our village's old{SoftNewLine}sayin' goes: 'The saved shall{SoftNewLine}show their true heart with a{SoftNewLine}shining stone.'{ContinuePrompt}

014D.t: {Speaker}Nigel, this is from{SoftNewLine}all of us in Massan. Please{SoftNewLine}take this jewel!{ContinuePrompt}

0150.t: {Speaker}It's just a rumor,{SoftNewLine}but they say the Gumi tribe is{SoftNewLine}ruled by an evil spirit...{WaitInput}

0152.t: {Speaker}Psst, Nigel... when{SoftNewLine}I was tied up, I got so scared{SoftNewLine}I wet myself a little. Don't{SoftNewLine}tell anyone!{ContinuePrompt}

015E.t: {Speaker}Hey, big bro! Ever{SoftNewLine}met folks who're a different{SoftNewLine}color than us?{NewLine}

0161.t: {Speaker}That's the Gumi{SoftNewLine}tribe. They hate us Massan{SoftNewLine}folk.{ContinuePrompt}

0162.t: {Speaker}Go south an' they'll{SoftNewLine}give ya the jiggly treatment!{WaitInput}

0163.t: {Speaker}I may be a kid, but{SoftNewLine}my courage ain't no smaller{SoftNewLine}than a grown-up's! I'll beat{SoftNewLine}'em up!{WaitInput}

0164.t: {Speaker}Waaah!... waaah!...{SoftNewLine}I was so scared...! Papa{SoftNewLine}chased 'em off to the swamp{SoftNewLine}shrine...{WaitInput}

0176.t: {Speaker}I may not look it,{SoftNewLine}but I'm an old lady... Long{SoftNewLine}ago, Massan and Gumi were the{SoftNewLine}best of friends.{ContinuePrompt}

0177.t: {Speaker}What started the{SoftNewLine}feud? Let's see, it was...{Pause1s}oh, I{SoftNewLine}forget!{ContinuePrompt}

0178.t: {Speaker}Go ask the Old Man{SoftNewLine}at the Waterfall Shrine. He'll{SoftNewLine}remember!{WaitInput}

0181.t: {Speaker}Hahaha, no need to{SoftNewLine}hide it! Years of experience, I{SoftNewLine}sensed it at once!{ContinuePrompt}

0183.t: {Speaker}Whoa! Really? Now,{SoftNewLine}now, lyin' is a bad habit,{SoftNewLine}young man!{WaitInput}

0184.t: {Speaker}Oho, I see, I see!{SoftNewLine}You just need more training!{SoftNewLine}Hahaha!{WaitInput}

019B.t: {Speaker}Big bro! Friday!{SoftNewLine}Let's go save Fara together!{SoftNewLine}...But my legs are shakin' so{SoftNewLine}bad I can't move!{WaitInput}

01AA.t: {Speaker}Fara was kidnapped{SoftNewLine}'cause she's the prettiest girl{SoftNewLine}in the village, even if she's a{SoftNewLine}kid. Oh my!{ContinuePrompt}

01AB.t: {Speaker}That means I'm{SoftNewLine}next! What should I do!{WaitInput}

01AC.t: {Speaker}I heard about your{SoftNewLine}exploits! I know, I know. It's{SoftNewLine}all thanks to EkeEke, right?{SoftNewLine}Ufufu!{WaitInput}

01C1.t: {Speaker}Grrrraaah! I've had{SoftNewLine}it! I'm never forgivin' those{SoftNewLine}guys!{WaitInput}

01C2.t: {Speaker}I ain't never met{SoftNewLine}anybody so brave. I really{SoftNewLine}respect ya!{WaitInput}

01C5.t: {Speaker}Those folks from{SoftNewLine}the south village are bein'{SoftNewLine}tricked by the Orcs! Fara's in{SoftNewLine}danger...{ContinuePrompt}

01C6.t: {Speaker}Nigel, I'm askin' you{SoftNewLine}too. Please, save Fara!{WaitInput}

01D6.t: {Speaker}The duke has{SoftNewLine}abandoned the town. Now he'll{SoftNewLine}stop at nothing.{ContinuePrompt}

01D8.t: {Speaker}Nigel! I beg of you!{SoftNewLine}Don't let him get the{SoftNewLine}treasures! Crush his ambition!{ContinuePrompt}

01DC.t: {Speaker}The village is in{SoftNewLine}the middle of a ritual.{SoftNewLine}Strangers, go on home!{WaitInput}

01DD.t: {Speaker}Heh heh... Welcome{SoftNewLine}to the village of Gumi.{WaitInput}

01DE.t: {Speaker}They say we were{SoftNewLine}bein' controlled by somethin'{SoftNewLine}called an Orc King.{ContinuePrompt}

01DF.t: {Speaker}Come to think of{SoftNewLine}it, I don't remember a thing.{WaitInput}

01E0.t: {Speaker}Oh, how utterly{SoftNewLine}shameful... Not only did{SoftNewLine}monsters defile our sacred{SoftNewLine}shrine...{ContinuePrompt}

01E1.t: {Speaker}they even{SoftNewLine}controlled us! We truly owe{SoftNewLine}Massan an apology. Please{SoftNewLine}forgive us.{WaitInput}

01E7.t: {Speaker}They say a witch{SoftNewLine}lives near Mercator. A real{SoftNewLine}old hag, I hear!{WaitInput}

01EC.t: {Speaker}Hold on a sec!{SoftNewLine}Emergency repair crew. We'll{SoftNewLine}have it open in{ContinuePrompt}

01EE.t: {Speaker}Phew, I'm beat.{SoftNewLine}...Oh, right! Emergency work's{SoftNewLine}done. You can go through{SoftNewLine}anytime now.{WaitInput}

01F3.t: {Speaker}They say you're{SoftNewLine}awful strong! Just don't{SoftNewLine}overdo it. If you're tired,{SoftNewLine}stay at my place.{ContinuePrompt}

0209.t: {Speaker}If you find the{SoftNewLine}treasures, give me half! Ho,{SoftNewLine}ho! Just kidding!{WaitInput}

0215.t: {Speaker}Next time you're in{SoftNewLine}town, I'll give you{SoftNewLine}extra-special service. Extra{SoftNewLine}special! Ufufu.{WaitInput}

022E.t: {Speaker}...fuga fuga... my{SoftNewLine}son is out right now...{WaitInput}

0231.t: {Speaker}...fuga fuga... I've{SoftNewLine}got a friend over in{SoftNewLine}Mercator... I wonder if she's{SoftNewLine}well...{ContinuePrompt}

0232.t: {Speaker}...her husband{SoftNewLine}collects jars for a hobby, I{SoftNewLine}think...fuga fuga...{WaitInput}

0234.t: {Speaker}Papa always says...{SoftNewLine}..men of the sea don't cry...{SoftNewLine}....sniff!...waaah...{WaitInput}

023B.t: {Speaker}Hahahahaha! Just{SoftNewLine}kidding! What an honest boy{SoftNewLine}you are!{WaitInput}

023F.t: {Speaker}The boss is out,{SoftNewLine}see. So I'll explain it for ya,{SoftNewLine}if that's all right.{ContinuePrompt}

0242.t: {Speaker}M-my...boss was{SoftNewLine}killed by the thieves... What{SoftNewLine}am I s'posed to do???{WaitInput}

0243.t: {Speaker}Waaah, waaah... I'm{SoftNewLine}sorry!... I'd never have done{SoftNewLine}it if I knew it was the duke's{SoftNewLine}scheme!{WaitInput}

0244.t: {Speaker}Waaah..... Please{SoftNewLine}let me out already... I'm{SoftNewLine}really, really sorry... waaah!{WaitInput}

0245.t: {Speaker}I'm a new man now!{SoftNewLine}Mr. Arthur's gonna whip me{SoftNewLine}into shape, you'll see!{WaitInput}

0255.t: {Speaker}We've decided!{SoftNewLine}You're an honorary citizen of{SoftNewLine}Ryuma! Hahaha!{WaitInput}

0259.t: {Speaker}Be a good boy and{SoftNewLine}go see the sights in town, kid!{WaitInput}

0271.t: {Speaker}This is Mercator...{SoftNewLine}When people think money is{SoftNewLine}everything, it's kind of sad,{SoftNewLine}isn't it...{WaitInput}

0273.t: {Speaker}My feet are sore{SoftNewLine}from standin' here all day{SoftNewLine}long, ya hear.{WaitInput}

0279.t: {Speaker}Wowie!! Madame{SoftNewLine}Yard's is wonderful! I want to{SoftNewLine}live in this town forever!{WaitInput}

027B.t: {Speaker}Your voice is{SoftNewLine}pretty high for a guy... Hasn't{SoftNewLine}broken yet, huh?{WaitInput}
